Although the leverage ratio is relatively high with total liabilities of $91.1B against shareholders' equity of $23.8B, the massive cash-generation capability, high gross margins (83%), and substantial asset base mitigate default risk significantly. This profile is consistent with a highly stable investment-grade issuer.
